[[File:Voontragi.jpg|thumb|300px]]
The [[Kentra]] thought '''voontragi''' were demons that inhabited the jungle on [[Orellon II]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] discovered that the "demons" were actually [[87-RM Scout Collector|collector]] and [[Wanderer Scout Surveyor|survey]] droids sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by a [[Species/Legends|race]] seeking a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] before they went extinct. The survey droids would stun any living creatures that encountered them in the jungle, and the collector droids would collect and flash freeze the specimens.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>

{{RPG|"[[The Prophecy]]"}}
After the Rebels defeated the survey and collector droids, the star-shaped [[base ship]] lifted off from the jungle floor, and blasted into the atmosphere.<ref name="TP" />
{{Endgame}}
